items.title: Career Opportunities In The Climate Change And Sustainability Sector
items.summary: On the first episode of Earth5R’s Sustainability Podcast, The Sustainability Lounge, renowned environmentalist and Earth5R founder Saurabh Gupta addressed college students, sharing insights about the exciting career opportunities in the climate change and sustainability sector.

items.title: Sustainability Career Launchpad Episode 3
items.summary: Top investors in this industry include Adani , Data Power , and ReNew Power. Engineers, technicians, analysts, and researchers work in this field. This industry includes solar, wind, hydropower, and biofuels.

items.title: Future-Proofing India’s Youth, Earth5R’s Sustainability Skill Training Model
items.summary: Discover how Earth5R’s sustainability skill training model is equipping India’s youth with green job skills in waste management, climate finance, and eco-entrepreneurship, aligning with Skill India and Startup India to build a resilient, future-ready workforce.

items.title: Creating Green Jobs Through Circular Economy: Earth5R’s Youth-Focused Framework
items.summary: The concept of a circular economy has rapidly gained global attention as a potential solution to some of the most pressing environmental and economic challenges of our time. Unlike the traditional linear economy, which follows a “take, make, dispose” model, the circular economy emphasizes resource efficiency, waste minimization.

items.title: The Attention Harvest: Instagram, Food Delivery & Fast Fashion Drain India's Teenage Potential
items.summary: India-specific policy investigation: How Instagram (481M users), Swiggy, Zomato, and Shein exploit teenage dopamine responses, draining mental health, nutrition, ₹25,000+/month from families, and generating 22,000 tonnes of plastic waste monthly
